name: GAN Portrait
summary: A square headshot of a person who does not exist: the eyes sit at a fixed height, the background is a soft swirl, and small faults show in teeth, ears and glasses. It spread from 2018 with StyleGAN.

philosophy.core_thesis: A face that nobody owns: the model averages thousands of faces into one believable head, and its faults are the signature.
design_principles: Centre one head at 1024px square with the eye line at 40% from the top and the eyes 30% of the width apart.
Set a blurred, swirled background of 2 to 3 warm hues at 25% to 40% blur strength.
Keep the shoulders at the lower 25% of the frame with a soft, plain garment.
Leave one small fault: a mismatched earring, a teeth blur, or a bright water-drop patch of 40px to 80px.
Align faces in a 4x4 grid of 256px tiles with a 8px gap to show many generated heads at once.
Use a plain caption in 14px sans below the tile; add the word generated and the seed number.
Keep the palette natural: skin tones, brown blur and one cool background tint.

layout.grid_mechanics: A grid of square tiles: 4 columns at 256px with 8px gaps, or one single 1024px tile; the caption sits under the tile.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the page stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Each face is centred in its tile and the eye lines of all tiles share one height.
layout.container_geometry: Square tiles with a 0px radius; caption chips with a 4px radius.

font_pairings.note: A neutral sans for plain captions and seed numbers.
A friendly sans with a mono seed line.

hierarchy_rules: Set the seed number in mono at 12px.

color.palette_structure: Natural skin and brown tones with one cool teal tint; the page is a quiet slate.
color.contrast_rules: Paper text on slate holds at least 12:1; teal carries links and small marks at 5:1 or more.
color.surface_treatment: Flat slate panels around the tiles; the faces carry soft, smooth skin with no pores below 1px.
color.light_and_shadow: Even, frontal, soft light with no hard shadow; the background glow is a diffuse blur.

materiality.surface_simulation: A digital studio portrait: smooth skin, soft light and a blurred backdrop.
materiality.border_rules: No border on tiles; a 1px hairline in #3A4150 between panels.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 25% to 40% blur on the background of each face only; panels are flat.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 20px with a 1.5px round stroke for refresh and download.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Anonymous headshots with a soft swirl background; no other art.

motion.transition_physics: Tiles cross-fade to a new face in 400ms; a latent morph between two faces runs 24 frames at 24 fps.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the tile by 2px; active shows the seed and the model name.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm unease: the face is friendly, and nobody is there.

use_cases: design tools that need anonymous faces
avoid_when: The page must show a real, named person.
The face could pass as a real identity in a harmful context.
The content needs bold, graphic character.

modifiers.how: Add a cinematic rim light, a teal and amber grade and finer skin detail.
Turn the headshot into a stylised avatar with a glow ground and a 4x5 pack grid.
Add a landmark overlay and a SYNTHETIC label chip.

pack.why: A quiet 1.5px line that keeps the faces as the only content.

ground.why: The ground copies the soft, diffuse backdrop that the model draws behind each face.

rounded-sm bg-[#2FB5A9] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-[#1B1F27] transition-transform duration-[400ms] hover:-translate-y-0.5

sources.title: Karras, Laine and Aila, A Style-Based Generator Architecture for Generative Adversarial Networks (2018)
